# R3BOOT | Integrated Recovery Center

> R3BOOT is pronounced Reboot. Official spelling is R3BOOT (R-3-BOOT). Legal name: R3boot Activelife Pvt Ltd. Integrated recovery and performance clinic in Dadar East and Lower Parel / Prabhadevi, Mumbai. Not Reroute & Reboot (Khar / Ghatkopar). Clinical physiotherapy, contrast therapy (infrared sauna + ice bath), sports massage, Pilates, compression therapy and aqua (hydro) therapy.

Also known as: Reboot Dadar, Reboot Lower Parel, Reboot clinic Mumbai, Reboot Recovery Centre.

Physiotherapy facts: 45-minute sessions, ₹2,000 per session. The first session includes the assessment and the first treatment. No doctor referral needed. Book by phone or WhatsApp on +91 97023 68612.

## Physiotherapy

- [Physiotherapy Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy): Assessment-led physiotherapy at R3BOOT Dadar and Lower Parel. Hands-on treatment, dry needling, progressive exercise and aquatic rehab.
- [Physiotherapy Dadar](https://www.r3boot.in/physiotherapy-dadar-mumbai): Dadar East clinic, 5 minutes from Dadar station (East exit).
- [Physiotherapy Lower Parel](https://www.r3boot.in/physiotherapy-lower-parel): Lodha Signet clinic, Lower Parel / Prabhadevi, near Worli, Kamala Mills and BKC.

## Condition Pages

- [Physiotherapy for Back Pain](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy/back-pain): Lower back pain, sciatica, slipped disc, upper back pain. Causes, warning signs, first visit, typical session ranges.
- [Physiotherapy for Neck Pain](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy/neck-pain): Desk neck, cervical spondylosis, arm tingling (cervical radiculopathy), neck headaches, whiplash.
- [Physiotherapy for Knee Pain](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy/knee-pain): Runner's knee, knee osteoarthritis, ligament sprains including ACL, meniscus and tendon pain.
- [Physiotherapy for Shoulder Pain](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy/shoulder-pain): Frozen shoulder, rotator cuff pain and tears, shoulder impingement.
- [Sports Injury Physiotherapy](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy/sports-injuries): Sprains, strains, pulled hamstrings, overuse injuries and return-to-sport testing.
- [Post-Surgery Physiotherapy](https://www.r3boot.in/services/physiotherapy/post-surgery): Rehab after ACL reconstruction, knee and hip replacement, spine and shoulder surgery, following the surgeon's protocol.
- [Aqua Therapy for Knee Pain](https://www.r3boot.in/aqua-therapy-for-knee-pain-mumbai): Aqua treadmill treatment for knee osteoarthritis, ACL recovery and joint pain.

## Recovery and Other Services

- [Contrast Therapy Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/services/contrast-therapy): Clinically structured infrared sauna and ice bath protocol supervised by physiotherapists. 3:1 hot-to-cold ratio.
- [Ice Bath Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/ice-bath-mumbai): Supervised cold immersion for muscle recovery.
- [Aqua Therapy Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/services/aqua-therapy): Aqua treadmill rehabilitation for knee pain, arthritis and post-surgical recovery.
- [Sports Massage Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/services/sports-massage): Performance-driven sports massage for athletes.
- [Pilates Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/services/clinical-pilates): Physiotherapy-led Pilates for rehabilitation and core strength.

## Practitioners

- [Dr. Hiral Parikh](https://www.r3boot.in/team/hiral-parikh): Lead Physiotherapist, BPT (Padmashree Dr. D.Y. Patil College of Physiotherapy), 15+ years clinical experience.
- [Dr. Vaishali Vijay Rauniyar](https://www.r3boot.in/team/vaishali-vijay-rauniyar): Physiotherapist, certified in dry needling and aquatic rehabilitation, 4+ years experience.
